messages.subject: Project Atlas - completion accounts query
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Quick one on Project Atlas (the Brampton Leisure acquisition) - our finance team has a question on the retention release mechanics in the completion accounts. Could someone give Miriam a call this week? Not urgent but we'd like it tidied before the deferred consideration falls due.

Thanks,
Nathan Reilly
Kingsford Group
